basis.text: Make everything a CLI plus a skill.

experiment: Write one skill for the daily routine (merge → process → classify → export → PR) that only calls `omni` commands; run it on two agents.
hypothesis: Thin skill files that call the `omni` CLI make the daily bookmark and tracks routines reproducible across agents and machines.
success_metric: Both agents complete the routine with no ad-hoc scripts.
title: Package omni grok-x / tracks routines as agent skills over the CLI

question: What exactly are 'ralph loops', and would one suit the daily bookmark routine?
why: A practitioner-debated pattern that could replace the scheduled routine.

basis.text: Indra beats PaddleOCR and Tesseract on a text benchmark.

experiment: Run Indra and Tesseract on the 18 uninspected visual bookmarks; compare text quality and time.
hypothesis: A fast CPU OCR model would let grok-x OCR every bookmarked image and frame sheet (tesseract isn't installed on the agent box).
success_metric: Usable text for most images at under 1s per image on CPU.
title: Evaluate Indra as grok-x's OCR backend

question: Is Indra open-weights and licensed for local use, and how do you install it?
why: Decides whether it can replace Tesseract in grok-x.

quotes: whenever you need sound effects search Openverse to find the best options
basis.text: Agents can search Openverse whenever sound effects are needed.

experiment: Add a small Openverse client to the clip/episode pipeline that records each clip's license and attribution; try it on one episode.
hypothesis: Giving episode-building agents an Openverse search step yields properly sourced sound design without manual downloads.
success_metric: One episode built with Openverse audio, all licenses and attributions recorded.
title: Openverse sound search for omniscience episode/clip builds

question: Which Openverse audio licenses (CC0/CC BY/BY-SA/NC) are acceptable for Noah's published episodes?
why: Licensing decides whether the tool is usable for published work.

quotes: model state machines and systems with concurrency using TLA+
basis.text: TLA+ is suggested for modeling state machines and concurrent systems, and the author found bugs this way.

experiment: Generate or hand-write a small TLA+ spec of intake apply, rollback and crash restore, and model-check interleavings with a concurrent writer.
hypothesis: The tracks intake commit (locks, journaled transaction, byte-for-byte rollback, crash recovery) is a concurrent state machine of the kind TLA+ modeling is said to catch bugs in.
success_metric: Spec model-checks clean, or at least one real bug is found and filed in beads.
title: Model-check the tracks intake journal and rollback

basis.text: One task per session keeps context clean.

experiment: Run the next 10 bd issues as one session each, starting from `bd prime` + `bd show <id>`; compare with mixed sessions.
hypothesis: Scoping each session to one bd issue (seeded with `bd prime` and `bd show`) reduces cross-task context pollution.
success_metric: Fewer reverted or redone changes and review findings per issue.
title: One fresh agent session per beads issue

quotes: It will save you much time explaining the same thing and make AI's replies more precise.
basis.text: A standing explanation of dependencies, deployment and file structure saves time and improves precision.

experiment: Add a 'Codebase map' section (packages, entry points, data dirs, deployment) to omniscience AGENTS.md and keep it current in PRs.
hypothesis: A short, current map of entry points and structure in AGENTS.md makes agent replies more precise and saves re-explanation.
success_metric: Agents stop asking or grepping for entry points; less time-to-first-change on new tasks.
title: Codebase brief in AGENTS.md (dependencies, deployment, file map)

quotes: call out anything that appears to be overengineering needlessly
basis.text: Plan in markdown, then a fresh agent critiques it for over-engineering.

experiment: For the next 5 non-trivial tasks, write the plan to a markdown file, run a fresh reviewer agent with the over-engineering prompt, and log what changed.
hypothesis: A fresh reviewer agent that critiques a markdown plan for over-engineering catches design problems before code review.
success_metric: Fewer automated-review rounds and findings per PR than the PR #5 baseline (8+ rounds).
title: Fresh-agent critique of written plans before implementation

quotes: Quality schema docs are a great investment for an engineering team
basis.text: Quality schema docs are a high-value investment for a team.

experiment: Generate docs/schema.md from omniscience/models with a short purpose line per table and column; check it in CI for drift.
hypothesis: Documented tables/columns (generated from SQLAlchemy models plus hand-written meaning) let agents write correct queries without reading model code.
success_metric: An agent answers 5 library/DB questions correctly using only docs/schema.md.
title: Generated schema docs for omniscience's Postgres tables

quotes: text embeddings don't understand non-text data
basis.text: Text embeddings don't understand non-text data.

experiment: Add optional date-range/source_type/author boosts to library search and compare precision@5 on 20 scoped queries.
hypothesis: Using published date, source_type and author as structured filters/boosts (instead of embedding them as text) improves retrieval precision for time- or source-scoped questions.
success_metric: precision@5 improves on scoped queries without regressing unscoped ones.
title: Treat dates, source type and author as structured signals in library search

question: Does omniscience's own transcribe-then-summarize path beat off-the-shelf long-video summarizers?
why: Decides whether to keep building in-house summarization for YouTube items.

quotes: now I'm going to start loading a bunch of information to this space
basis.text: Master prompt plus uploaded documents in one space.

experiment: For one queue item, build a space: dossier + 10-K/transcripts + a master prompt requiring citations; review answer quality.
hypothesis: Starting each investment research task from the theme dossier as a master prompt, plus uploaded primary documents, gives auditable, cited answers.
success_metric: Every answer claim has a primary-source citation; the question is closed or narrowed.
title: Per-theme research spaces for the investment research agent

quotes: write custom evaluators for every one of these
basis.text: Custom evaluators per item, built with a model and an eval workflow.

experiment: Write an evaluator that scores each takeaway's overlap with content/<id>*.md and run it on the 74 bookmarks; review the lowest 10.
hypothesis: A cheap evaluator per summary (every takeaway must have lexical support in the fetched content) catches ungrounded summaries before export.
success_metric: Finds real ungrounded takeaways with less than 20% false positives in the reviewed set.
title: Per-item grounding evaluators for grok-x summaries
